gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-tasa-orbiter: TASA Orbiter reads crisp and unclogged, even its smallest counters staying open. Bellota Text stands over it with a distinctive, stroke-flat display voice, and the two keep each other honest on the page.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-teachers: Modern and contemporary, Teachers looks like thin steel rod bent into letters, with ink strokes that taper off before they touch. Bellota Text makes it feel boldly distinctive.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-telex: Telex reads clean and curvy, its sans-serif letters feeling unclamped and loose. But Bellota Text, with stencil-cut letters of one steady width, gives the pair its commanding, distinctive punch.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-tenor-sans: Tenor Sans reads contemporary, its c tips never creeping toward touching and its crossbars a touch thinner than the stems. And Bellota Text holds a stencil-cut constant weight that suits headings, while the sans handles the finer work.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-tirra: Round and open, like parentheses everywhere you look, Tirra is the plain sans here, while Bellota Text holds a pen line at one width throughout. They sit together simply.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-titillium-web: Bellota Text brings tubular strokes like bent copper pipe, commanding and distinctive, and it leads with open c, e and s shapes. Titillium Web follows, its stroke ends set far apart.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-tomorrow: Tomorrow reads neutral and clean, its bowls opening like a cupped palm of clay. Bellota Text is best at commanding attention with tubelike, constant-weight lines, while the sans is best at quietly carrying the words.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-trispace: Trispace spreads sparse, widely set letters whose curves open outward instead of curling in, which makes it approachable. Bellota Text does its best work as a display voice with parallel stroke edges, while the sans-serif handles text.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-tsukimi-rounded: Tsukimi Rounded is clean and neutral, with round forms that read like open parentheses and parallel stroke edges through every curve. Bellota Text goes bigger above it, and the plain sans sits smaller below.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-tuffy: Tuffy reads professional and contemporary, as if sketched with a pencil that never presses harder, its s widely parted. Over a longer passage it feels steady and unfussy.
